title.hinglish: Printer paper kam pad raha hai

body.en: The stationery cupboard has about two weeks of paper left. Your stationery budget is healthy this quarter.
body.hinglish: Stationery cupboard mein lagbhag do hafte ka paper bacha hai. Is quarter stationery ka budget theek-thaak hai.

text.en: Order the usual monthly amount
text.hinglish: Hamesha jitna monthly order dein

text.en: Order a year's stock at once
text.hinglish: Poore saal ka stock ek saath mangayein

text.en: Wait and see how it goes
text.hinglish: Dekhte hain, abhi rukte hain

continuation.en: The order goes to the stationery supplier today.
continuation.hinglish: Order aaj stationery supplier ko bhej diya jaata hai.

title.en: Two deadlines land on one Friday
title.hinglish: Do deadlines ek hi Shukravaar ko aa gayi

body.en: The client report and the audit file are both due on Friday. The team can finish only one of them properly by then.
body.hinglish: Client report aur audit file dono Shukravaar ko due hain. Team tab tak sirf ek ko theek se poora kar sakti hai.

text.en: Agree a one day extension for one of them, in advance
text.hinglish: Pehle se ek ke liye ek din ki extension tay karein

text.en: Rush both and submit them at 6 pm
text.hinglish: Dono jaldi mein karke shaam 6 baje jama karein

text.en: Say nothing and hope nobody asks
text.hinglish: Kuch na kahein aur umeed karein ki koi na poochhe

continuation.en: The calendar is updated with the new plan.
continuation.hinglish: Calendar naye plan ke saath update ho jaata hai.

body.en: Rs 40,000 of the training budget is unspent with six weeks to the financial year end. Unused money lapses.
body.hinglish: Training budget ke Rs 40,000 abhi kharch nahi hue aur financial year ant mein chhe hafte hain. Bacha hua paisa lapse ho jaata hai.

text.en: Book a two-day workshop the whole team can attend
text.hinglish: Do din ki workshop book karein jisme poori team aa sake

text.en: Fund online courses chosen against each person's current work
text.hinglish: Har kisi ke abhi ke kaam ke hisaab se online courses fund karein

text.en: Let the unspent amount lapse
text.hinglish: Bacha hua paisa lapse hone dein

continuation.en: Finance notes the plan in the training tracker.
continuation.hinglish: Finance plan ko training tracker mein darj kar leta hai.

title.en: Two caterers quote for the annual meet
title.hinglish: Annual meet ke liye do caterers ke quotes

body.en: One caterer is cheaper but needs full payment upfront. The other costs 15 per cent more and takes payment after the event.
body.hinglish: Ek caterer sasta hai par poora paisa pehle maangta hai. Doosra 15 pratishat mehnga hai aur event ke baad payment leta hai.

text.en: Choose the dearer caterer with payment after the event
text.hinglish: Mehnga caterer chunein jo event ke baad payment leta hai

text.en: Choose the cheaper caterer and pay upfront
text.hinglish: Sasta caterer chunein aur pehle payment karein

text.en: Ask for a third quote and delay the decision a week
text.hinglish: Teesra quote maangein aur faisla ek hafte taalein

continuation.en: The caterer's name goes on the event sheet.
continuation.hinglish: Caterer ka naam event sheet par chadh jaata hai.

title.hinglish: Kal raat ka backup fail ho gaya

body.en: The overnight backup of the shared drive failed. IT says it can be rerun tonight, but a restore test would take half a day.
body.hinglish: Shared drive ka overnight backup fail ho gaya. IT kehta hai aaj raat dobara chal sakta hai, par restore test mein aadha din lagega.

text.en: Rerun tonight and schedule the restore test this week
text.hinglish: Aaj raat dobara chalayein aur restore test is hafte rakhein

text.en: Rerun tonight and skip the test
text.hinglish: Aaj raat dobara chalayein aur test chhod dein

text.en: Wait for the weekly backup
text.hinglish: Weekly backup ka intezaar karein

continuation.en: IT logs the failure in its incident sheet.
continuation.hinglish: IT is failure ko apni incident sheet mein darj karta hai.

title.en: A demo on the eve of a holiday

body.en: A client asks for the product demo at 5 pm on the day before a long weekend. Most of the team plans to leave by 3 pm.
body.hinglish: Ek client long weekend se ek din pehle shaam 5 baje product demo maangta hai. Zyadatar team 3 baje nikalne ka plan banaye hui hai.

text.en: Offer 11 am that day or first thing after the weekend
text.hinglish: Usi din subah 11 baje ya weekend ke turant baad ka slot dein

text.en: Accept 5 pm and ask two people to stay
text.hinglish: 5 baje maan lein aur do logon ko rukne ko kahein

text.en: Decline and say the team is unavailable
text.hinglish: Mana kar dein ki team available nahi hai

continuation.en: The client gets a calendar invite by evening.
continuation.hinglish: Shaam tak client ko calendar invite mil jaata hai.

body.en: {recall} forwards you two quotes for the projector rental. One is cheaper, the other includes setup support and a spare lamp.
body.hinglish: {recall} ne aapko projector rental ke do quotes forward kiye hain. Ek sasta hai, doosre mein setup support aur spare lamp shamil hain.

text.en: Take the quote with setup support and a spare lamp
text.hinglish: Setup support aur spare lamp wala quote lein

text.en: Take the cheaper quote
text.hinglish: Sasta quote lein

text.en: Buy a projector instead, outside this quarter's budget
text.hinglish: Projector khareed lein, jo is quarter ke budget se bahar hai

continuation.en: The rental is confirmed for the date of the event.
continuation.hinglish: Rental event ki tareekh ke liye pakka ho jaata hai.

body.en: Four people need to visit the Pune site next month. A train and hotel plan costs Rs 28,000. Flights cost Rs 46,000 but save a day.
body.hinglish: Agle mahine chaar logon ko Pune site jaana hai. Train aur hotel plan Rs 28,000 ka hai. Flights Rs 46,000 ki hain par ek din bachati hain.

text.en: Train and hotel, with the saved money kept for site costs
text.hinglish: Train aur hotel, bachaya paisa site costs ke liye rakhein

text.en: Flights for everyone to save the day
text.hinglish: Sabke liye flights, taaki ek din bache

text.en: Send two people only and cover the rest by video
text.hinglish: Sirf do log jaayein aur baaki video par judein

continuation.en: The travel desk gets the request on Thursday.
continuation.hinglish: Travel desk ko request Guruvaar ko mil jaati hai.

title.en: A software licence expires next week
title.hinglish: Ek software licence agle hafte khatam hoga

body.en: The design software licence ends in seven days. Renewal takes three working days to process, and the price rises on the 1st.
body.hinglish: Design software ka licence saat din mein khatam hota hai. Renewal process hone mein teen working days lagte hain, aur daam 1 tareekh ko badhte hain.

text.en: Raise the renewal today at the current price
text.hinglish: Aaj hi maujooda daam par renewal ki request daalein

text.en: Wait for the new price list before deciding
text.hinglish: Faisla karne se pehle nayi price list ka intezaar karein

text.en: Let it lapse and use the free version for now
text.hinglish: Lapse hone dein aur abhi free version use karein

continuation.en: Procurement files the request in its queue.
continuation.hinglish: Procurement request ko apni queue mein daal deta hai.

title.hinglish: Review ka hafta tyohaar ke hafte se takraya

body.en: The quarterly review falls in festival week, when several people are on leave. Moving it means the board sees numbers a week late.
body.hinglish: Quarterly review tyohaar ke hafte mein pad rahi hai, jab kai log chhutti par hain. Ise khiskane ka matlab hai ki board ko numbers ek hafta der se milenge.

text.en: Move it a week and send the board a short note
text.hinglish: Ek hafta aage karein aur board ko chhota note bhejein

text.en: Hold it online with a shorter agenda
text.hinglish: Chhote agenda ke saath online rakhein

text.en: Hold it as planned with whoever is in
text.hinglish: Jaisa plan tha waise hi rakhein, jo log hain unke saath

continuation.en: The review date is posted on the team calendar.
continuation.hinglish: Review ki tareekh team calendar par daal di jaati hai.

title.hinglish: Courier se do deliveries chhoot gayi

body.en: The courier firm delivered late twice this month, once to a client. A rival firm offers a trial month at a slightly higher rate.
body.hinglish: Courier firm ne is mahine do baar der se delivery ki, ek baar client ko. Ek rival firm thoda zyada rate par trial mahina offer karti hai.

text.en: Take the trial month and keep the old firm as a backup
text.hinglish: Trial mahina lein aur purani firm ko backup rakhein

text.en: Send the old firm a written warning and review in a month
text.hinglish: Purani firm ko likhit chetavani dein aur ek mahine baad review karein

text.en: Drop the old firm today and move everything
text.hinglish: Aaj hi purani firm hatayein aur sab kuch shift karein

continuation.en: The courier log gets a note about this month.
continuation.hinglish: Courier log mein is mahine ka note jod diya jaata hai.

title.hinglish: Ek client der se payment karta hai

body.en: A client is 45 days late on an invoice of Rs 1.2 lakh. They hint that a discount would speed things up.
body.hinglish: Ek client Rs 1.2 lakh ke invoice par 45 din der kar chuka hai. Woh ishaara dete hain ki discount se kaam tez ho sakta hai.

text.en: Chase with a dated reminder and offer a small early-payment discount
text.hinglish: Tareekh wala reminder bhejein aur chhota early-payment discount offer karein

text.en: Chase firmly with no discount and escalate to their finance head
text.hinglish: Bina discount sakhti se follow up karein aur unke finance head tak le jaayein

text.en: Give the full discount they hinted at
text.hinglish: Unke ishaare wala poora discount de dein

continuation.hinglish: Finance receivables sheet update karta hai.

body.en: {recall} sends you a comparison of two cleaning vendors. One is cheaper per month, the other asks for a longer contract with a notice period.
body.hinglish: {recall} ne aapko do cleaning vendors ki tulna bheji hai. Ek mahine ke hisaab se sasta hai, doosra lambe contract aur notice period maangta hai.

text.en: Take the cheaper vendor on a three-month trial
text.hinglish: Sasta vendor teen mahine ke trial par lein

text.en: Take the longer contract for a lower rate
text.hinglish: Kam rate ke liye lamba contract lein

text.en: Keep the current vendor without comparing further
text.hinglish: Aur tulna kiye bina maujooda vendor rakhein

continuation.en: Admin is told the outcome by email.
continuation.hinglish: Admin ko nateeja email se bata diya jaata hai.

title.en: Fire drill and client visit clash
title.hinglish: Fire drill aur client visit ek saath

body.en: The mandatory fire drill is set for Tuesday morning, the same time as an important client visit. The drill must happen this month.
body.hinglish: Zaroori fire drill Mangalvaar subah tay hai, usi waqt jab ek ahem client visit hai. Drill isi mahine hona zaroori hai.

text.en: Move the drill to Thursday and tell the safety officer today
text.hinglish: Drill Guruvaar ko le jaayein aur safety officer ko aaj batayein

text.en: Hold the drill and move the client to the afternoon
text.hinglish: Drill rakhein aur client ko dopahar mein shift karein

text.en: Skip the drill this month
text.hinglish: Is mahine drill chhod dein

continuation.en: The safety officer files the revised plan.
continuation.hinglish: Safety officer sanshodhit plan file kar leta hai.

body.en: The offsite venue offers two dates: a cheaper midweek slot that overlaps a deadline, or a weekend slot that costs 20 per cent more.
body.hinglish: Offsite venue do tareekhein deta hai: sasta hafte ke beech ka slot jo ek deadline se takraata hai, ya weekend slot jo 20 pratishat mehnga hai.

text.en: Take the midweek slot after moving the deadline a day
text.hinglish: Deadline ek din khiska kar hafte ke beech ka slot lein

text.en: Take the weekend slot and give a day off in lieu
text.hinglish: Weekend slot lein aur badle mein ek din ki chhutti dein

text.en: Cancel the offsite this season
text.hinglish: Is season offsite radd kar dein

continuation.en: The venue holds the date for 48 hours.
continuation.hinglish: Venue tareekh 48 ghante ke liye rok leta hai.

title.en: An error in last month's invoices
title.hinglish: Pichhle mahine ke invoices mein galti

body.en: A data entry error shows three invoices were under-billed by about Rs 15,000 in total. None of the clients has noticed.
body.hinglish: Data entry ki galti se teen invoices kul milakar lagbhag Rs 15,000 kam bill hue. Kisi client ne abhi dhyan nahi diya.

text.en: Correct the records and send the clients a short corrected invoice
text.hinglish: Records theek karein aur clients ko chhota sudhaara hua invoice bhejein

text.en: Correct the records and absorb the loss quietly
text.hinglish: Records theek karein aur nuksaan chupchaap utha lein

text.en: Leave it unless a client raises it
text.hinglish: Jab tak koi client na uthaye, aise hi chhod dein

continuation.en: Finance adds the correction to the month-end checklist.
continuation.hinglish: Finance sudhaar ko month-end checklist mein jod deta hai.
